newsitem.title: USA: World Airways CEO Pollard steps down.
newsitem.headline: World Airways CEO Pollard steps down.

text.p: World Airways Inc said on Friday that Charles Pollard has stepped down as president and chief executive. The chairman, Coleman Andrews, will serve as interim CEO until a successor is found.

The company said in a statement that Pollard had told the board he wanted to leave when his contract expired at the end of 1997, but the board wanted an executive team in place now with a long-term commitment to the company and its business strategy.
Pollard, in a statement issued separately, said his tenure at World has ended and he will pursue other interests. He had served as World's president since 1992 and as its chief executive since 1996.

World is 61 percent owned by WorldCorp Inc, 18 percent owned by MHS Berhad of Malaysia and 21 percent by public investors. Its shares were trading at 7-5/8 on the Nasdaq early Friday afternoon, down 1/2 a point.
